continuous_scalar.temporal_species_state: median of all valid measurements for that species within the family x trait system after canonical-unit validation
continuous_scalar.temporal_dissimilarity: absolute difference after positive affine standardization within the family x trait system
continuous_scalar.spatial_dissimilarity: the same absolute-difference definition; any positive common scaling is rank-invariant for the primary Spearman effect
continuous_scalar.numeric_validity_before_value_opening: aggregate-only parseability audit must show all nonmissing eligible trait_value entries are numeric; raw values are not returned
continuous_scalar.unit_rule: exactly one nonempty canonical BIEN unit label for the trait among qualifying records, unless a conversion is explicitly frozen from source documentation before values are opened

nominal_categorical.temporal_species_state: unique modal category across valid measurements; species with a tied mode are excluded deterministically and cannot be rescued by alternative aggregation
nominal_categorical.unit_rule: no physical-unit conversion is permitted; unit labels must be absent or source-documented as unitless

traits.reason: Cyclic calendar/phenological phase is not represented by the frozen scalar absolute-difference or nominal mismatch dissimilarities; no circular metric was predeclared.
The trait name alone does not uniquely establish scalar versus categorical state semantics; fail closed before support results rather than infer representation from values.

primary_hold.rule: These traits cannot enter the primary H1/H2 trait synthesis in BIEN v0.3. They are not replaced by nearby traits and may only be reconsidered in a separately preregistered future extension.

post_value_fail_closed_rules: If deterministic species-state aggregation reduces temporal support below 20 species, exclude that family x trait system.
If valid measurement filtering reduces spatial support below 8 species each meeting the frozen 20-record/5-cell rule, exclude that family x trait system.
Do not substitute a different trait, unit, aggregation, or dissimilarity after values are opened.
independence_rule: scrubbed_family remains the independence cluster; multiple qualifying traits from one family do not create additional independent families for the >=12 gate.
